title: negative adjustment blocked when it would make stock go below zero
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). GET /api/items to find an active item (use the first one). GET /api/transactions/stock-position to find its current stock at ADEL. Then POST /api/transactions/adjustments with that itemId, location='ADEL', quantity=-(currentStock + 100) (a number that exceeds available stock), reason='Damage', notes='test negative floor'. Expect 400 response with error containing 'negative stock'. Then POST a valid small negative adjustment (quantity=-1) with the same item — expect 201 success.

title: Cycle Count reason rejected on manual adjustments
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). GET /api/items to find an active item. POST /api/transactions/adjustments with that itemId, location='ADEL', quantity=-1, reason='Cycle Count', notes='test'. Expect 400 response with validation error indicating 'Cycle Count' is not a valid reason. Valid reasons are: Damage, Shrinkage, Correction, Other.

title: deactivating item with positive stock is blocked
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). GET /api/items to find an active item. GET /api/transactions/stock-position to confirm it has stock > 0 at some location. Then PATCH /api/items/:id/status with body {isActive: false}. Expect 400 response with error containing 'Cannot deactivate item with' and 'units on hand'.

title: deactivating item with zero stock succeeds
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). POST /api/items to create a new test item with body {itemCode:'TEST-DEACT-001', description:'Test Deactivation Item', category:'Test', unitOfMeasure:'EA'}. This item has zero stock (no transactions). Then PATCH /api/items/:id/status with body {isActive: false}. Expect 200 success. Then PATCH again with {isActive: true} to reactivate, expect 200.

title: transfer uses serializable transaction to prevent race condition
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). GET /api/items to find an active item. GET /api/transactions/stock-position to find its stock at ADEL. POST /api/transactions/transfers with that itemId, fromLocation='ADEL', toLocation='CALHOUN', quantity=(currentStock + 100) — exceeding available. Expect 400 with error containing 'Insufficient stock'. Then POST a valid transfer with quantity=1 — expect 201 success with outbound and inbound transactions.

title: kitting with retired BOM is rejected
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). GET /api/boms to find an active BOM. Note its id and components. PATCH /api/boms/:id/status with body {status:'RETIRED'} to retire it. Then POST /api/production/kit with that bomId, the correct finishedGoodId (GET /api/boms/:id to find it), location='ADEL', quantityProduced=1, and the correct components array. Expect 400 with error containing 'RETIRED' and 'Only ACTIVE BOMs'. Finally, PATCH /api/boms/:id/status with {status:'ACTIVE'} to restore it.
